about: The drift ceiling (#530, ruled 2026-09-29): past this share of a project's primary catalogue entries drifted (yellow or red in the currency report), a session re-validates one batch before it wraps. Superseded AT THE WRAP on 2026-10-14 by a direction (drift-gate.js --since-start: fewer drifted than at session start), because at ~83% drifted any useful ceiling fails on day one; a numeric ceiling returns once the count has gone down. Still read by scripts/drift-gate.js with no flag; change it only by a ruling on #530 or its successor.
